messages:
morgan: RC v2.14.0-rc3 built and pinned (sha: abcdef12). Planning promotion tonight 23:00 PT -> prod. Canaries: 5% for 15m, then 30% for 10m, then full. DB change is a small index add (backfill safe). Need QA + SRE sign-offs. Release notes draft: https://go/release-notes/rc-v2.14.0-rc3 :rocket:

 tia: QA ran a quick smoke against staging, samples look good. no regressions in core generation. +1

 james: SRE - can do 23:00 PT. we'll watch 5xx and token latency. Alert thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% sustained 5m OR p95 latency up 2x -> abort.

 deploy-bot: Promotion job queued: job_id=98765, artifact=rc-v2.14.0-rc3, canary_policy=5% for 15m -> 30% for 10m -> 100%. Start window OK.

 patrick: quick question - are we pinning model weights to quantized-v8 variant? that was a late change.

 morgan: yes pinned to quantized-v8 (tested locally + soak). fallback to float32 variant on high error rates is configured in routing policy.

 sre-elaine: i'll be sheriff for this window. rollback playbook (short):
 1) run `deploy abort 98765`
 2) pin traffic to previous artifact `rc-v2.13.9` via routing control
 3) if DB issues, run migration rollback `dbmigrate revert 20250602_idx`
 I'll open a parallel incident if we hit >0.5% errors.

 qa-sam: leaving a short smoke checklist to run once canary is live:
 - /health on all prod hosts OK
 - sample generation passes schema tests (`pytest tests/smoke_samples.py`)
 - rerank sanity check (10 queries)
 - rate limiter sanity

 james: adding monitoring & runbook links: https://go/ops/runbooks/rc-promo and dashboard: https://go/dashboards/rc-rc3

 morgan: release notes call out: index add (non-blocking) and known emoji tokenization diff. please amplify in customer-facing notes if needed.

 deploy-bot: Promotion started: job_id=98765 -> canary stage 1 (5%). Logs: https://go/build/98765/log

 sre-elaine: watching metrics now, setting quiet-window (suppress non-essential alerts). :eyes:

 tia: QA ack for production smoke after canary1. will run checks and report back in 10m.

 deploy-bot: Canary stage 1 healthy after 18m. Proceeding to stage 2 (30%).

 morgan: thanks all — if rollback needed ping here and call the 10m timer. otherwise i'll post full promotion confirmation after final stage.

 deploy-bot: Promotion complete: job_id=98765 -> success. prod artifact=rc-v2.14.0-rc3

 patrick: post-check: perf p95 looks stable, errors normal baseline. closing out. :tada:
